barrier.scope: unrestricted genuinely mixed occurrence polarity in connected signed Huang equality composition
barrier.source_bound_consequence: By the already sealed Schaefer dichotomy authority, the unrestricted Boolean CSP over this signed language is NP-complete because the finite language lies in none of the frozen tractable classes.
barrier.connected_consequence: A polynomial exact carrier covering every connected unrestricted instance of this signed language, together with ordinary connected-component decomposition, would place that NP-complete language in P and therefore imply P=NP.
barrier.interpretation: This is a P-vs-NP-scale barrier to routine carrier closure, not a proof that no carrier exists.

C10_effect.meaning: Breaking C10 at mixed polarity does not by itself yield a lower bound; it exposes the exact signed Boolean CSP barrier.

explicit_nonclaims: No proof that a polynomial signed-Huang carrier is impossible.
